{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
n_converted = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_loyal

print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate:.4f}")"}
